zoom_levels_observed: full-body wide single (subject 65-71% of frame height)
framing_style.description: Two sources intercut. (A) The 'date' footage: subjects background-removed and composited on a flat synthetic light-grey plate (RGB~207,199,199, std~1.8) with a white outer glow hugging the silhouette and a soft contact shadow. (B) A reaction-panel: blue-lit studio, yellow couch, cast reacting. 14 of 28 cuts stay inside one source (reframe), 14 cross between A and B. Within source A the frame is LOCKED: scale-matching over shots 8 and 17 returns s=1.000 with 0.0% error improvement over s=1.0, i.e. measurably zero push-in; singles and two-shots are crops of one continuous wide master (pose is continuous across A->A cuts, e.g. 21.483 -> 21.583). Push-in is reserved for source B and is violent, not gentle: shot 24.767-25.767 measures +10% in 0.22s (+46%/s, err 34.6 vs 51.0) reaching +31% cumulative; shot 31.883-33.917 measures +23.6% over 1.92s (+12.3%/s, err 42.3 vs 56.9). No handheld shake and no global pan: a +/-12px translation search returns near-zero error gain on every shot, so apparent offsets are subject motion, not camera. No speed ramps, but one 0.18s freeze-frame hold at 10.82-11.00s just before a cut. Subject vertical centre is pinned at 50-51% of frame height in every wide/two-shot framing (measured 49.9 / 50.5 / 50.6 / 50.7 / 50.9 / 50.6); head-top 15-25%, feet 78-86%. Horizontal centre roams 33-69%.

caption.position: centred horizontally; block BOTTOM-anchored at y=982/1920 = 51.1% of frame height, growing upward for multi-line cards. Single line spans y 898-982 (centre 49.0-49.9%), cap height 84-86px = 4.4% of frame height. Separate branded lockup lower down at 68-76% (hook title and outro CTA).
caption.style_description: Heavy bold condensed sans, ALL CAPS, tight tracking, upright (the branded lockup is italic). One card replaces the previous wholesale - 1 to 3 words, mean 1.9. Cards are independent of cuts and persist across them. Sound effects are captioned in asterisks (*BARKS*).
caption.color: #FFFFFF white / #FD609C pink / #FDDF27 yellow. COLOUR ENCODES WHO IS SPEAKING, NOT WHAT IS ON SCREEN: white = the male lead, pink = his female date, yellow = the reaction-panel cast. Proven by cards that contradict the picture - white 'YOURSELF' at 9.52s and pink 'ALL THE' at 18.38s both sit over reaction-panel shots because the speaker is off-screen. Cyan #0AF8F9 is never a speech colour; it is reserved for the second line of the branded lockup ('ON A DATE', 'IN BIO').
caption.outline: thick black outline ~10px at 1080 width (~12% of cap height) plus a soft blurred black drop shadow offset down-right
caption.animation: 1-frame snap pop. Measured on the pink 'ALL THE' entry: absent at k1102; present at k1103 at 0.84x width / 0.82x height with partial alpha (1012 colour-matched px); full 1.00x at full opacity at k1104 (9887 px); then pixel-constant through k1115. Total entry ~33ms with NO overshoot above 1.0 - distinct from an elastic pop. It is a per-card animation, not a full-frame ramp: the underlying picture is unchanged between k1103 and k1104 outside the text bounding box, and the same instant scale-up recurs at every card change independent of cuts.

effects: background-removal cutout of subjects onto a flat grey plate with white outer glow + soft contact shadow
red full-frame wash ramping on before a cut (2.60->3.15s and 31.73->31.87s), released by the cut
outro strobe: composite ramps to full black and snaps back, twice (34.6-35.08s, 35.9-36.62s)
blown-white flash frames in the outro (k2137, k2161)
per-letter build-on of the outro 'CHECK LINK IN BIO' lockup (k2077-2089)
persistent branded lockup: white+cyan italic, hook title 'SIGMA SPEED / ON A DATE' and outro CTA
small circular channel watermark composited mid-frame throughout
0.18s freeze-frame hold at 10.82-11.00s immediately before a cut
link emoji in the outro CTA
slight vignette on the grey plate (corner ~202 vs centre ~208)
hook: Opens on a tight chest-up close-up of the male lead and SNAP ZOOMS OUT: scale-matching gives 0.81x by k6 and 0.76x by k12, then locked - a -24% punch-out completed in 0.2s. The branded lockup 'SIGMA SPEED' (white) / 'ON A DATE' (cyan), italic, animates in at 68-76% of frame height by k4 and holds for the whole first ~2s. Speech cards run above it at the 49% line, one short card at a time: 'SO YOU JUST' (k15) -> 'LOOK AT THEIR' (k30) -> 'FACES BE LIKE' (k45, caught mid-pop) -> 'NO' (k75). First cut lands at 1.400s. No question posed to camera - the hook is the punch-out plus the title lockup.
audio: Integrated -13.6 LUFS, LRA 6.0 LU, true peak +0.1 dBFS (clipping). Opus 48kHz stereo. Loud, heavily compressed social master. Music bed present: the noise floor never drops out - quiet passages between lines stay well above silence and momentary loudness sits in a narrow -16 to -19 LUFS band with an LRA of only 6.0 LU, which raw dialogue would not hold. Dialogue is source audio from the two shoots sitting on top of that bed. No discrete whoosh/impact sfx tied to the cuts was isolable from the bed.
notes: COMPLETE. Method: the inherited 61 candidates came from FULL-FRAME MAD>12, which on this clip conflates three different kinds of event. Re-derived from gray135.raw with the caption band (38-72% of frame height) MASKED OUT - this clip needs a masked band, not merely 'upper frame', because the branded lockup sits at 68-76%, below a naive upper-region cut. Real cuts scored nocap 45-163; caption-only swaps scored nocap 7-14 with a cap/nocap ratio of 2.0-4.3 (e.g. 3.783s nocap 7.3 ratio 3.21; 18.167s nocap 8.8 ratio 4.33; 29.850s nocap 11.2 ratio 3.97) - clean separation. Third class: sustained plateaus (isolated-spike ratio vs local median < 5), which are subject motion, the 25.0-25.4s panel push-in, and the outro strobe. Every survivor and every borderline was confirmed on labelled before/after pairs at k-3/k+3 (sheets P_cut_0..3, P_chk_0..1, P_rej, T_outro). Net: 61 -> 28. Removed 33: 8 caption-only swaps, 23 motion/plateau frames, and 2 that both the mechanical pass and my own first threshold called cuts but frames disproved - 35.083s and 36.617s are the strobe snapping back from black inside one continuous shot, not shot changes. Added 2 the mechanical pass under-ranked: 1.400s and 11.017s (11.017 was masked by a simultaneous caption change, giving it a misleading cap/nocap of 2.01). SEPARATE FINDING: the video is 30fps content duplicated into a 60fps container - 48% of consecutive frame-diffs are near-zero in a near-alternating cadence - so cut times land on the 30fps grid and the caption pop is a 30fps event. NOT DETERMINED: (a) whether the reaction-panel shots come from one wide master reframed or from multiple cameras - the panel framings differ too much to settle from frames alone, so the 24.767s panel->panel cut is counted as same-source; if it is a camera change, same_scene_reframe_pct drops to 46.4%. (b) The exact caption typeface - a heavy condensed grotesque, but no reliable identification from raster frames. (c) Whether discrete sfx accent the cuts, since a continuous music bed masks them and no stem is available. (d) The easing curve of the two panel push-ins - endpoints and average rate were measured, but the sampling is too coarse to distinguish linear from eased.
